procedures.name: RunCheck
procedures.doc: Performs comprehensive validation checks on a general journal line before posting. Validates account numbers, amounts, dimensions, dates, and posting setup requirements.

procedures.name: GetErrors
procedures.doc: Retrieves error messages collected during journal line validation checking. Returns all validation errors found during the RunCheck procedure execution.

procedures.name: DateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed based on general ledger setup restrictions. Validates against posting date restrictions in general ledger setup.

procedures.name: DeferralPostingDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed for deferral transactions based on setup restrictions. Validates against deferral-specific posting date restrictions.

procedures.name: DateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed for the specified journal template based on setup restrictions. Validates posting date against template-specific and user-specific posting date limitations.

procedures.name: IsDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed based on user setup and general ledger setup restrictions. Provides detailed setup record information for troubleshooting date restriction issues.

procedures.name: IsDeferralPostingDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed for deferral transactions with detailed setup information. Validates against deferral-specific posting date restrictions and provides setup record details.

procedures.name: IsDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Checks if a posting date is not allowed for the specified journal template with detailed setup information. Validates posting date against template-specific restrictions and provides setup record details for troubleshooting.

procedures.name: SetGenJnlBatch
procedures.doc: Sets the general journal batch context for validation operations. Configures the batch context used during journal line validation checks.

procedures.name: SetSkipFiscalYearCheck
procedures.doc: Sets whether to skip fiscal year validation during date checking. Controls fiscal year boundary validation during journal line validation.

procedures.name: ErrorIfPositiveAmt
procedures.doc: Validates that journal line amount is not positive and raises error if it is. Used for transaction types that should only have negative amounts (e.g., payments).

procedures.name: ErrorIfNegativeAmt
procedures.doc: Validates that journal line amount is not negative and raises error if it is. Used for transaction types that should only have positive amounts (e.g., receipts).

procedures.name: SetOverDimErr
procedures.doc: Sets flag to override dimension error handling during validation. Allows dimension validation errors to be bypassed during checking process.

procedures.name: SetIgnoreJournalTemplNameMandatoryCheck
procedures.doc: Sets flag to ignore journal template name mandatory validation. Bypasses the requirement for journal template name during validation checks.

procedures.name: CheckSalesDocNoIsNotUsed
procedures.doc: Validates that a sales document number is not already used in existing customer ledger entries. Prevents duplicate sales document numbers to maintain document integrity and audit trail.

procedures.name: CheckPurchDocNoIsNotUsed
procedures.doc: Validates that a purchase document number is not already used in existing vendor ledger entries. Prevents duplicate purchase document numbers to maintain document integrity and audit trail.

procedures.name: CheckDocType
procedures.doc: Validates document type compatibility with account types and enforces amount sign requirements. Ensures document type and amount combinations comply with business logic for various account types.

procedures.name: IsVendorPaymentToCrMemo
procedures.doc: Determines if a journal line represents a vendor payment being applied to a credit memo. Used for payment logic and document type validation in payment journals.

procedures.name: ThrowGenJnlLineError
procedures.doc: Throws a formatted error for journal line validation failures with contextual information. Provides structured error handling with journal line context and detailed error messages.

procedures.name: SetBatchMode
procedures.doc: Sets batch processing mode to control validation behavior during bulk operations. Modifies validation logic to accommodate batch processing requirements.

procedures.name: CheckGenProdPostingGroupWhenAdjustForPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Validates general product posting group is specified when VAT setup requires payment discount adjustment. Ensures proper posting group configuration for payment discount VAT calculations.

procedures.name: CheckBalGenProdPostingGroupWhenAdjustForPmtDisc
procedures.doc: Validates balancing general product posting group is specified when VAT setup requires payment discount adjustment. Ensures proper balancing posting group configuration for payment discount VAT calculations.

procedures.name: SetLogErrorMode
procedures.doc: Sets error logging mode to control error handling behavior during validation. Enables or disables error collection mode for dimension management and validation processing.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckAccountNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing account number validation for journal lines. Enables custom validation logic and processing after standard account number checks are completed.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckBalAccountNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing balancing account number validation for journal lines. Enables custom validation logic and processing after standard balancing account number checks are completed.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing all journal line validation checks. Enables custom validation logic and error handling after standard journal line validation is completed.

procedures.name: OnAfterDateNoAllowed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after checking if a posting date is not allowed based on user permissions and setup. Enables custom date validation logic and override of standard date restrictions.

procedures.name: OnAfterDeferralPostingDateNoAllowed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after checking if a deferral posting date is not allowed based on deferral setup and permissions. Enables custom deferral date validation logic and override of standard deferral date restrictions.

procedures.name: OnBeforeDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing date validation checks for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard date validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeIsDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before determining if a posting date is not allowed. Enables custom date validation logic to override standard date restriction checks.

procedures.name: OnBeforeIsDeferralPostingDateNotAllowed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before determining if a deferral posting date is not allowed. Enables custom deferral date validation logic to override standard deferral date restriction checks.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckAccountNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing account number validation for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard account number validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckBalAccountNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing balancing account number validation for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard balancing account number validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckDimensions
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing dimension validation for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard dimension validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckDocType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating document type and amount combinations for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard document type validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckBalDocType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating balancing document type and amount combinations for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard balancing document type validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckICPartner
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing intercompany partner validation for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard IC partner validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSalesDocNoIsNotUsed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating sales document number uniqueness in customer ledger entries. Enables custom logic to completely override standard sales document number duplication checking.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckPurchDocNoIsNotUsed
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating purchase document number uniqueness in vendor ledger entries. Enables custom logic to completely override standard purchase document number duplication checking.

procedures.name: OnBeforeErrorIfNegativeAmt
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating that journal line amount is not negative. Enables custom logic to override negative amount error handling for specific scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeErrorIfPositiveAmt
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating that journal line amount is not positive. Enables custom logic to override positive amount error handling for specific scenarios.

procedures.name: OnBeforeRunCheck
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before performing the main journal line validation check. Enables custom logic to completely override standard journal line validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeTestDocumentNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating document number field requirements for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard document number validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeTestAccountAndBalAccountType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating account and balancing account type compatibility for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard account type compatibility validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeTestAppliesToID
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating applies-to ID field requirements for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard applies-to ID validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckPostingDateInFiscalYear
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating posting date against fiscal year boundaries for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard fiscal year date validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckDates
procedures.doc: Integration event raised at the beginning of the CheckDates procedure before any date validation is performed. Enables custom validation logic on journal line fields as part of the initial validation phase.

procedures.name: OnCheckDimensionsOnAfterAssignDimTableIDs
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after assigning dimension table IDs during dimension validation processing. Enables custom dimension table assignments and modification of dimension validation scope.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckAccountType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating account type and posting type compatibility for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard account type validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckBalAccountType
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating balancing account type and posting type compatibility for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard balancing account type validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckAppliesToDocNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating applies-to document number requirements for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard applies-to document validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckJobNoIsEmpty
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating that job number field is empty for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard job number validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckZeroAmount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating that journal line amount is not zero. Enables custom logic to completely override standard zero amount validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckElectronicPaymentFields
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating electronic payment fields for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard electronic payment validation processing.

procedures.name: OnBeforeIsVendorPaymentToCrMemo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before determining if a vendor payment applies to a credit memo. Enables custom logic to completely override standard vendor payment to credit memo logic.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckVATDate
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating VAT reporting date for journal lines. Enables custom logic to completely override standard VAT date validation processing.

procedures.name: OnCheckSalesDocNoIsNotUsedOnAfterSetFilters
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting filters for sales document number duplication validation. Enables custom filter modifications during sales document number uniqueness checking.

procedures.name: OnCheckAccountNoOnBeforeCheckICPartner
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking intercompany partner setup during account number validation. Enables custom logic to override IC partner checking for specific account scenarios.

procedures.name: GetGLReg
procedures.doc: Returns the G/L Register that has been created during the posting process.

procedures.name: RunWithCheck
procedures.doc: Wrapper for the main procedure which checks and posts the journal line. As a result G/L Entries and Register are created along with other related ledger entries.

procedures.name: RunWithoutCheck
procedures.doc: Wrapper for the main procedure posts the journal line without checking it. As a result G/L Entries and Register are created along with other related ledger entries.

procedures.name: IsGLEntryInconsistent
procedures.doc: Specifies if the General Ledger Entries that have been created during the posting process are inconsistent.

procedures.name: ShowInconsistentEntries
procedures.doc: Shows a list of all inconsistent G/L Entries that has been produced during the posting.

procedures.name: InitLastDocDate
procedures.doc: Assignes information (Document Type, Document No., Posting Date) fron Gen. Journal Line to the global variables.

procedures.name: InitVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes the G/L Entry for posting VAT depending on the VAT Posting of the Gen. Journal Line.

procedures.name: PostVAT
procedures.doc: Creates and inserts VAT Entries for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. If Gen. Journal Line requires Sales Tax, VAT Entries are created and inserted for each Tax Line that is needed.

procedures.name: InsertVAT
procedures.doc: Creates and inserts VAT Entry for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. If Calculation Type is Sales Tax, VAT Entries are filled with Tax related information. VAT Posting Parameter is created to be used for the VAT Entry.

procedures.name: SummarizeVAT
procedures.doc: Creates G/L Entries for VAT. If summarization is needed, before creating new entry existing ones in TempGLEntryVAT. buffer are checked. If entry in the buffer for the same G/L Account and Bal. Account already exists, just the amount is increased.

procedures.name: InsertSummarizedVAT
procedures.doc: Inserts summarized VAT G/L Entries for the Gen. Journal Line that is being posted. Summarized entries are taken from TempGLEntryVAT buffer.

procedures.name: RunPostFixedAsset
procedures.doc: Wrapper procedure for external call of PostFixedAssetPostFixedAsset, which is used for posting a Gen. Journal Line with Account Type Fixed Asset. G/L Entries, VAT Entries and FA Ledger Entries are created.

procedures.name: PostJob
procedures.doc: Wrapper procedure for external call of PostJob, which is used for posting a gen. journal line with account type job. G/l entries, job entries, usage related ledger entries (resourse or item and value), possibly warehouse entries are created.

procedures.name: StartPosting
procedures.doc: Initialize global variables and G/L Register for new posting batch, locks needed tables.

procedures.name: ContinuePosting
procedures.doc: If new transaction needs to be started, Unrealized VAT is check and posted, global values initialized for the new transaction. Currency is updated for the new Gen. Journal Line that is being posted, current Balance of the posting is updated.

procedures.name: ResetTransactionState
procedures.doc: Invalidates the transaction-scoped caches in this codeunit so the next call to RunWithCheck is forced through StartPosting (which re-takes the G/L Entry table lock and re-reads the last entry number from disk) instead of taking the ContinuePosting fast path with a stale NextEntryNo.

procedures.name: FinishPosting
procedures.doc: Checks if transaction is balanced for both local and additional currencies, inserts all G/L Entries that were created for the Gen. Journal Line. If posting is performed for application purpose, original Customer and Vendor Ledger Entries are updated to reflect that. Cost journal line is posted if co...

procedures.name: InitGLEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes g/l entry from gen. journal line.

procedures.name: InitGLEntryVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes g/l entry from gen. journal line and summarizes VAT g/l entries.

procedures.name: InitGLEntryVATCopy
procedures.doc: Initializes a general ledger entry for VAT posting with data copied from an existing VAT entry. Creates G/L entry with dimension and posting details derived from the source VAT entry.

procedures.name: InsertGLEntry
procedures.doc: Updates the amounts of the g/l entry and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryBalAcc
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line. Fills balance account information and adds it to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryVAT
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and detailed cv. ledger entry buffer, adds the g/l entry to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted. Inserts vat entries.

procedures.name: CreateGLEntryVATCollectAdj
procedures.doc: Initializes the g/l entry from the general journal line and detailed cv. ledger entry buffer, adds the g/l entry to the TempGLEntryBuffer to be inserted. Collects needed adjustments, inserts vat entries.

procedures.name: CalcCurrencyUnrealizedGainLoss

params.name: TempDtldCVLedgEntryBuf
params.type: Record "Detailed CV Ledg. Entry Buffer" temporary

procedures.doc: Calculates unrealized gains and losses, if there are any then detailed CV ledger entries are created.

params.name: TempDtldCVLedgEntryBuf
params.type: Record "Detailed CV Ledg. Entry Buffer" temporary

procedures.name: CalcAmtLCYAdjustment
procedures.doc: Calculates the difference in local currency between the actual remaining amount of the c/v ledger entry and the remaining amount based on the adjusted currency factor. If there is a difference then detailed CV ledger entries are created and posted to equate the difference.

procedures.name: ApplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts customer ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed customer ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new customer ledger entry.

procedures.name: CustPostApplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the customer ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, customer ledger entries and detailed customer ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: PostDtldCustLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed customer ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: ApplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts vendor ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed vendor ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new vendor ledger entry.

procedures.name: ApplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Prepares and posts employee ledger entries needed for the application. Detailed employee ledger entries are created and posted for both the old and the new employee ledger entry.

procedures.name: VendPostApplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the vendor ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, vendor ledger entries and detailed vendor ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: EmplPostApplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Stand-alone procedure to post (from check to finish) application gen. journal line for the employee ledger entries. G/l entries, vat entries, employee ledger entries and detailed employee ledger entries are created and posted.

procedures.name: PostDtldVendLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed vendor ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: PostDtldEmplLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Posts all detailed employee ledger entries that are stored in DtldCVLedgEntryBuf. Creates g/l entry for the total amounts.

procedures.name: PostDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Depending on the detailed customer/vendor ledger entry type, creates g/l entry and other entries for the detailed customer/vendor ledger entry. If general journal line is created not for the unapplication purpose, adjustments can be collected.

procedures.name: PostUnrealVATEntry
procedures.doc: Posts an unrealized VAT entry for general journal line processing. Handles unrealized VAT scenarios where VAT is posted upon payment rather than invoice.

procedures.name: PostApply
procedures.doc: Posts application entry to and applies it to the already existing customer/vendor/employee ledger entry. In the process g/l entries and detailed entries are created, existing customer/vendor/employee ledger entries are updated.

procedures.name: UnapplyCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed customer ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related customer ledger entry is being updated as part of the process Unrealized vat is posted

procedures.name: UnapplyVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed vendor ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related vendor ledger entry is being updated as part of the process Unrealized vat is posted

procedures.name: UnapplyEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Creates and posts un-applying entry for currently applied detailed employee ledger entry. G/l entry with unapplied amount is created as part of the process Related employee ledger entry is being updated as part of the process

procedures.name: GLCalcAddCurrency
procedures.doc: Calculates additional currency amount for G/L posting based on various posting scenarios. Handles currency conversion, rounding, and posting rules for additional currency setup.

procedures.name: CalcLCYToAddCurr
procedures.doc: Converts amount to additional reporting currency

procedures.name: ExchangeAmtLCYToFCY2
procedures.doc: Converts amount from local to foreign currency.

procedures.name: CheckNonAddCurrCodeOccurred
procedures.doc: Checks and returns if the currency code is different than additional reporting currency

procedures.name: SetGLRegReverse
procedures.doc: Sets parameter ReverseGLReg to the same value as global variable GLReg with reversed set to true.

procedures.name: ABSMin
procedures.doc: Returns smaller value of the two parameters passed to the procedure.

procedures.name: GetGLSetup
procedures.doc: Retrieves general ledger setup if it wasn't retrieved before. Global variable to store additional reporting currency is set from general ledger setup.

procedures.name: GetSourceCodeSetup
procedures.doc: Retrieves and caches the source code setup for posting operations. Optimizes performance by reading the setup once and reusing it across posting operations.

procedures.name: CheckDimValueForDisposal
procedures.doc: Check dimension restrictions on gen. journal line that relates to g/l account.

procedures.name: SetOverDimErr
procedures.doc: Sets the global variable OverrideDimErr for the current instance of the codeunit. If OverrideDimErr is not set dimension check is performed before posting gen. journal line

procedures.name: SetPreviewMode
procedures.doc: Sets the Preview Mode for the current instance of the codeunit. Preview Mode ensures no transactions are committed to the database.

procedures.name: CheckGLAccDimError
procedures.doc: Check dimension restrictions on gen. journal line that relates to g/l account.

procedures.name: SetIgnoreJournalTemplNameMandatoryCheck
procedures.doc: Sets the global variable IgnoreJournalTemplNameMandatoryCheck for the current instance of the codeunit. If IgnoreJournalTemplNameMandatoryCheck is not set "Journal Templ. Name Mandatory" check is performed before gen. journal line

procedures.name: GetCurrency
procedures.doc: Retrieves currency record based on the currency code.

procedures.name: CollectAdjustment
procedures.doc: Populates the array AdjAmount with gen. journal lines value amount and additional currency amount.

procedures.name: HandleDtldAdjustment
procedures.doc: Handles detailed adjustment entries for currency and rounding differences in posting. Creates additional G/L entries to balance out adjustment amounts from currency conversions and rounding.

procedures.name: GetAdjAmountOffset
procedures.doc: Returns offset of adjustment amount. If amount positive and amount in additional currency is greater than 0 (zero) return value will be 1. If not - return value will be 3.

procedures.name: GetNextEntryNo
procedures.doc: Returns next entry no. that should be used when creating ledger (i.e. general, customer, vendor, etc.) entries.

procedures.name: GetNextTransactionNo
procedures.doc: Returns next transaction no. that should be used when creating ledger (i.e. general, customer, vendor, etc.) entries.

procedures.name: GetNextVATEntryNo
procedures.doc: Return next vat entry no. that should be used when creating next vat entry.

procedures.name: IncrNextVATEntryNo
procedures.doc: Increases global variable NextVATEntryNo by 1 (one).

procedures.name: IncrNextEntryNo
procedures.doc: Increases global variable NextEntryNo by 1 (one).

procedures.name: IsTempGLEntryBufEmpty
procedures.doc: Procedure to check if global temporary/buffer table TempGLEntryBuf is empty.

procedures.name: UpdateGLEntryNo
procedures.doc: Parameter GLEntryNo is updated with value of parameter SavedEntryNo. Global variable NextEntryNo is decreased by 1 (one).

procedures.name: UpdateTotalAmounts
procedures.doc: Creates/updates temporary/buffer table TempDimPostingBuffer with amount and amount in additional currency based on dimension set id. The procedure should be used to aggregate amounts by dimensions.

procedures.name: SetAddCurrForUnapplication
procedures.doc: Updates additional-currency amount on buffer table DtldCVLedgEntryBuf when un-application of customer/vendor ledger entries is posted.

procedures.name: CheckCustMultiplePostingGroups
procedures.doc: Checks if multiple customer posting groups exists on customer ledger entries that relate to detailed entries being created.

procedures.name: CheckVendMultiplePostingGroups
procedures.doc: Checks if multiple vendor posting groups exists on vendor ledger entries that relate to detailed entries being created.

procedures.name: CheckEmplMultiplePostingGroups
procedures.doc: Checks if multiple employee posting groups exists on employee ledger entries that relate to detailed entries being created.

procedures.name: RemoveDeferralSchedule
procedures.doc: Removes deferral header and line associated with gen. journal line.

procedures.name: SetFADimAlreadyChecked
procedures.doc: Sets the new value for global variable FADimAlreadyChecked.

procedures.name: SetTempGLEntryBufEntryNo
procedures.doc: Sets entry no. of the global temporary/buffer table TempGLEntryBuf.

procedures.name: Code
procedures.doc: Executes the reminder creation process for the configured customer and ledger entry filters.

procedures.name: Set
procedures.doc: Initializes the reminder creation parameters for batch processing of customer reminders.

procedures.name: SuggestLines
procedures.doc: Suggests reminder lines for an existing reminder header based on overdue customer ledger entries.

procedures.name: FilterCustLedgEntries
procedures.doc: Applies filters to customer ledger entries based on the specified reminder level.

procedures.name: SetReminderLine
procedures.doc: Calculates the reminder level and due date for a customer ledger entry based on previous reminder history.

procedures.name: AddLineFeeForCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Adds a line fee for a customer ledger entry if applicable based on reminder level settings.

procedures.name: OnAfterCode
procedures.doc: Raised after the reminder creation process completes.

procedures.name: OnAfterFilterCustLedgEntryReminderLevel
procedures.doc: Raised after filters are applied to customer ledger entries based on reminder level.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitReminderLine
procedures.doc: Raised after a reminder line is initialized with default values.

procedures.name: OnAfterMakeReminder
procedures.doc: Raised after a reminder document is created with all its lines.

procedures.name: OnAfterSet
procedures.doc: Raised after the reminder creation parameters are set.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetReminderLine
